lines.text: The nations taunt the man who makes himself rich with many loans, and his creditors will suddenly arise against him.
He builds his house by unjust gain to escape disaster, but the stones will cry out from the wall.
Woe to him who builds a city with bloodshed; the earth will fill with the knowledge of the LORD's glory.
The man who made his neighbors drunk will be filled with sorrow, and his violence against Egypt will overwhelm him.
Idols have no breath, but the LORD is on the high mountain, and all the earth must be silent.
